title: The settings of a part only some of them have can still be reached
goal: Pick five boxes where three have a fill. The Fill row says the picked layers disagree, but the row goes blank: the only move on offer is the switch, which gives all five a fill. A part only some of the picked layers have should still show its colour, speaking for the ones that have it.
notes:
PartsInspector.PartRowView: opens = isOn && row.hasSettings, so a mixed row hides its chevron. The old Shadow section did this already: ShadowInspector draws its sliders for selection.shadows, the subset that has one. The parts list threw that away when the switch moved up onto the row. Found while doing a-switch-says-mixed-the-way-every-other-control (audit 2026-09-06-switch-says-mixed, rough 3).

2026-09-08: the panel had moved since this was filed. Shadow left Appearance for the Effects list on 2026-09-07, and an effect row already unfolds its settings whatever the picked layers are doing, so the row this is actually about is Fill — the one row in Appearance that still has a switch. PartRowView drew the colour only while row.isOn, so a mixed row fell through to MixedWord and offered nothing to set. Fixed by gating on the new LayerPartRow.showsSettings (true as soon as one picked layer has the part); the colour machinery already painted only the layers that HAVE the slot (ColorStyleSelection.members), so the reach came for free. OffPartColorDrop is now active only while nobody has the part, so the swatch and the row never both take a drop. Walk: Scripts/playtest/mixed-part-keeps-its-colour-walk.json.
acceptance: A part row over layers that disagree about having it still shows its colour
A colour picked there changes only the picked layers that have that part, in one undo step
The line under the row still says how many of the picked layers it reaches
A part no picked layer has still shows no colour at all

log.note: goal and acceptance rewritten for the panel that exists: Shadow is an Effects row now and already unfolds; Fill is the row that still went blank
reproduced on the probe: with 3 boxes and 1 hollow the Fill row offered only Switch (Fill, mixed) and no Color at all
shipped: LayerPartRow.showsSettings + PartsInspector shows the colour while mixed; caption reworded; 4931 tests pass and 7 panel walks green

A part row over layers that disagree about having it now shows its colour, and a colour picked there paints only the ones that have it, in one undo step. LayerPartRow.showsSettings + PartsInspector; OffPartColorDrop now only takes the row while nobody has the part; Appearance caption reworded. Verified on the probe: before, the Fill row over 3 boxes with 1 hollow offered only Switch (Fill, mixed); after, it offers Color too, a colour let go on it leaves fill at x2, and one undo puts both back. 4931 tests green, 7 walks green, audit 2026-09-08-mixed-part-keeps-its-colour.
